alt: A short film with no voice, with music. A room with a table. Two small block figures with white eyes, an ink-black one on the left and a royal blue one on the right. The black one says so I said, then boom, with a proud pulse. The blue one answers mm with narrowed eyes. The black one asks get it, the blue one says yeah, flatly. The black one starts to explain with because, and the blue one slowly closes its eyes and tilts. At the end both narrow their eyes at the camera. The text stays: me explaining my own joke.
